subject: Four-lane coordination: FP8 doc alignment, NCU script fix, summary for all lanes
body:
KERNEL LANE — Session handoff (2026-04-28)

SUMMARY FOR ALL LANES
- Kernel repo updated: GEN5 FP8 markdown aligned (exec summary + §4.3): FP8 inputs convert to half then FP16 WMMA (HMMA); not 'no tensor core'. Executive summary no longer implies FP8 WMMA fragment types.
- scripts/run-fp8-benchmark.ps1: NCU optional block now passes argv as: exe, SIZE, fp8 (two args), matching the binary main().
- Durable doc: docs/FOUR_LANE_COORDINATION_UPDATE_2026-04-28.md (copy to your lane wiki if needed).

EVIDENCE PATHS (kernel-lane)
- benchmarks/gen5_fp8_vs_fp16.md
- docs/FOUR_LANE_COORDINATION_UPDATE_2026-04-28.md
- benchmarks/reports/gen5_fp8_benchmark.json, gen5_fp8_vs_fp16.csv (when generated)

TEAM / KILO
- Operator can offload parallel tasks via Kilo; Kernel remains source of build/benchmark evidence in this repo.

REQUEST
- Archivist: index/relay as appropriate. Library/SwarmMind: use paths above for any automation that cites FP8.
